issues.claim: Certified Dermatology, 200 Perrine Rd Suite 226, Old Bridge (category 'Dermatologist / dermatopathology')
issues.problem: Excluded type that survived the sweep. The practice's own locations page (njdermdoc.com) says it runs 32 offices under one brand, well past the mapper's own stated limit of 5 offices; a search summary of the same page also reported 32 locations. It is a multi-office brand, not a local independent practice.
issues.fix: Remove. If dermatology coverage matters, keep Dermatology Associates of Central NJ (4 offices, within the limit) and look for solo derm practices instead.

issues.claim: Oakwood Dental Arts, 3689 US-9, Old Bridge (category 'Dentist (group practice)')
issues.problem: Excluded type. The practice's own locations page states 'Access All 8 Practices From Staten Island to New Jersey' and lists eight offices (four Staten Island, Freehold, Middletown, Old Bridge, Ramtown) under one Oakwood Dental brand. Also, the list leaves the website blank although the site is statenislanddentist.com.
issues.fix: Remove under the mapper's own 5+ office rule, or record an explicit owner exception before outreach.

issues.claim: Mission Pet Health, 2000 US-9, Old Bridge (category 'Veterinarian')
issues.problem: Excluded type plus unverified address. 'Mission Pet Health' is a national corporate veterinary group (formerly Southern Veterinary Partners; a 2026 SEC filing cited in search reports 930+ locations nationwide), not a local independent clinic. The only Old Bridge evidence is a shopping-centre tenant listing and one bulk directory, and the entry itself carries no confirmed address or phone.
issues.fix: Drop the entry. If a clinic exists at Glenwood Green, record its clinic-level trading name only after confirming it on the clinic's own page.

issues.claim: Old Bridge Dental, 125 Highway 516 (flagged in notes as DSO-supported)
issues.problem: Borderline excluded type left unresolved. The contact page's schema.org data names Dental Care Alliance, LLC (a national dental support organisation, Sarasota FL) as parentOrganization, i.e. the practice is corporately backed even though it trades under a local name. The mapper flagged it but did not decide.
issues.fix: Owner must decide whether DSO-backed practices count as chains; if yes, remove, if no, add a one-line justification so the same test is applied to the remaining dental entries.

issues.claim: Bombshell Aesthetic Medical Spa, 4010 US Highway 9, Old Bridge
issues.problem: Could not be confirmed anywhere. The single cited YellowPages page returns 403 to fetch, and my own searches for a 'Bombshell' med spa on Route 9 in Old Bridge returned nothing usable. It may be closed or operating only on social media; a phone number and hours from one unopenable directory are not enough for outreach.
issues.fix: Verify by phone or drop from the list before any outreach.

issues.claim: Black Belt Academy of Old Bridge, 2550 US-9 (Taekwondo / kickboxing school)
issues.problem: Thin evidence and an address conflict. The only cited source (dojos.info) shows 2550 U.S. 9 but does not state the business is currently operating, and a YellowPages summary returned by search shows 2500 U.S. Highway 9. The dojos.info URL slug ('OldBridgeATA') hints at an ATA-licensed school, which would need a franchise check, but no source I opened states that.
issues.fix: Check the school's own site or phone before use; confirm street number and whether it is an ATA licensee.

issues.claim: HER Heart Counseling Center, Old Bridge ('telehealth-only', no website, no address)
issues.problem: The note is not supported and the website is missing. The practice has its own site, herheartcounseling.com (returned by search, with a different published number than the listed 732 one), and its Psychology Today listing says in-person appointments may be available in Old Bridge rather than telehealth-only. The entry is therefore both under-described and internally inconsistent.
issues.fix: Open herheartcounseling.com, record the real address/phone or confirm virtual-only, and rewrite the note accordingly.

issues.claim: Entries with a blank website although one exists
issues.problem: At least three businesses publish their own sites but are recorded with no website: Smile Cares Family Dentistry (smilecaresnj.com, 2640 County Road 516, 732-679-0009 - opened, confirms address and phone), Allied Dental of Old Bridge (allieddentalofoldbridge.com, returned by search), Old Bridge Vision Center (oldbridgevision.net, returned by search).
issues.fix: Fill in the three websites; these are the easiest outreach-ready entries in the beauty/dental block.

issues.claim: Source URL https://mountainmartialartsnj.com/all-classes for Mountain Martial Arts
issues.problem: The cited URL now returns HTTP 404. The domain root still opens and confirms the Old Bridge dojo (248 Texas Rd) and that the school is also linked to a Holmdel dojo, so the business is sound but the citation is dead.
issues.fix: Replace the dead citation with https://mountainmartialartsnj.com/ or the contact page.

issues.claim: Proper Iron (formerly Jersey Strong Old Bridge), 2685 County Rd 516
issues.problem: The cited page does not publish the address or any phone; the address in the entry comes from elsewhere. The rebrand itself checks out (homepage headline 'Jersey Strong Old Bridge Is Becoming' and Jersey Strong's own support page), and Jersey Strong now lists only two NJ clubs, so the 2-5 office test is satisfied.
issues.fix: Cite jerseystrong.com/location/old-bridge/ (which still publishes 2685 County Rd 516 and 732-952-8999) alongside properiron.com, or keep 'Unknown' phone and note the address source.

issues.claim: Scissors by Sandy, The Shoppes at Old Bridge, 3813 US-9 North, Suite 101
issues.problem: The cited site confirms the business and owner (Sandra Mordan, master barber) but the page text I fetched contains no street address or suite, so the suite-level address is unsourced.
issues.fix: Confirm the suite against the salon's booking page or phone, or downgrade the address to '3813 US-9 North (suite unconfirmed)'.

issues.problem: Two eligible, outreach-ready Old Bridge practices found in my own searches are absent: Soft Touch Dental Care (3893 County Rd 516, 732-607-6400 - its own site, though it blocks fetching behind a client-side handshake) and In Step Podiatry (2477 County Rd 516 Suite 201, 732-679-6400). The mapper even mentions Soft Touch in a note ('not to be confused with') without listing it.
issues.fix: Add both; podiatry in particular has only three entries for a township this size.
